Name: Fresh Fish - Mineral Town - Compatibility Fix
Author: viccallan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fixed naming compatibility with the Bonito causing errors and menu flickering when checking the Stardew Aquarium donation list.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Use Mod manager or[/*]
[*]unzip and drop the unzipped folder into  the Stardew Valley\Mods folder, say yes when it asks if you want to replace the files.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fixed a compatibility issue.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mod will be removed  if either mods are updated. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fresh Fish and Mineral Town[/color]
